3. Calculate the time it takes for the second train to catch up:
   The second train needs to close the 60-mile gap created by the first train's head start.
   Time = Distance / Speed = 60 miles / 20 miles/hour = 3 hours.

4. Determine the time when the trains meet:
   The second train leaves at 7:00 AM and it takes 3 hours to catch up, so they will meet at 7:00 AM + 3 hours = 10:00 AM.
